labelPurpose: Relief of mild to moderate pain and reduction of fever.
labelDirections: Take as directed by a healthcare professional or package label. Swallow whole with water.
warnings: Do not exceed the stated dose.
Overdose may cause serious liver damage.
Do not take with other paracetamol-containing products.
sourceTitle: National List of Essential Medicines (NLEM) 2022 / NHS UK Paracetamol Monograph

labelPurpose: Relief of fever, headache, body aches, and mild to moderate pain.
labelDirections: Take as directed by a physician. Allow at least 4 to 6 hours between doses.
warnings: Do not exceed 4 tablets in 24 hours.
Excessive intake can harm liver function.
Consult physician if fever persists longer than 3 days.
sourceTitle: National List of Essential Medicines (NLEM) 2022 / Central Drugs Standard Control Organization (CDSCO)
notes: Higher strength paracetamol formulation common in blister packaging.

labelPurpose: Relief of symptoms associated with seasonal and perennial allergic rhinitis, and urticaria.
labelDirections: Take one tablet once daily with water, with or without food.
warnings: May cause drowsiness; avoid driving or operating machinery if affected.
Avoid alcohol while taking this medicine.
Consult doctor before use in kidney impairment.

labelPurpose: Relief of pain and inflammation in conditions such as arthritis, dental pain, and muscular aches.
labelDirections: Take with or immediately after food to reduce stomach irritation.
warnings: Do not take if you have a history of stomach ulcer or gastrointestinal bleeding.
Use lowest effective dose for shortest necessary duration.
Not recommended during the third trimester of pregnancy.

labelPurpose: Treatment of bacterial infections including respiratory tract, ear, and urinary tract infections.
labelDirections: Space doses evenly throughout the day. Complete the prescribed course even if feeling better.
warnings: Do not use if allergic to penicillin or beta-lactam antibiotics.
Complete the entire course to prevent antimicrobial resistance.
Seek medical advice if severe watery diarrhea occurs.
sourceTitle: WHO Model List of Essential Medicines / NHS UK Amoxicillin

labelPurpose: Treatment of gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD) and gastric acid-related conditions.
labelDirections: Swallow whole with water approximately 30 to 60 minutes before breakfast. Do not crush or chew.
warnings: Do not crush or chew the enteric-coated tablet.
Long-term use may reduce magnesium or vitamin B12 absorption.
Inform doctor if symptoms persist after 2 weeks.

labelPurpose: Reduction of stomach acid in conditions including heartburn, acid reflux, and peptic ulcers.
labelDirections: Take once daily in the morning before food. Swallow capsule whole.
warnings: Do not open or crush the granules inside the capsule.
May mask symptoms of more serious gastrointestinal conditions.

labelPurpose: Treatment of susceptible bacterial infections including respiratory tract, skin, and genital infections.
labelDirections: Take once daily at the same time each day with or without food. Complete the full prescribed course.
warnings: Take exactly as prescribed; do not skip doses.
Inform physician if experiencing heart rhythm changes or severe dizziness.
Antacids containing aluminum or magnesium should not be taken simultaneously.
sourceTitle: WHO Model Formulary / DailyMed FDA Azithromycin

labelPurpose: Management of type 2 diabetes mellitus to help improve glycemic control.
labelDirections: Take with meals to reduce gastrointestinal side effects. Swallow whole with water.
warnings: Rare risk of lactic acidosis; avoid excessive alcohol intake.
Inform physician prior to procedures requiring iodinated radiocontrast dyes.
Requires monitoring of renal function.

labelPurpose: Treatment of hypertension (high blood pressure) and angina pectoris (chest pain).
labelDirections: Take once daily, at the same time each day, with or without food.
warnings: Do not stop taking this medication abruptly without consulting your physician.
May cause peripheral edema (swelling of ankles).
Avoid grapefruit and grapefruit juice while taking amlodipine.

labelPurpose: Lowering cholesterol and reducing the risk of cardiovascular events.
labelDirections: Take once daily, usually in the evening, with or without food.
warnings: Report unexplained muscle pain, tenderness, or weakness to your doctor immediately.
Avoid excessive alcohol and large quantities of grapefruit juice.
Not recommended during pregnancy or breastfeeding.

labelPurpose: Lowering blood cholesterol and reducing cardiovascular risk in higher-risk patients.
labelDirections: Take once daily in the evening with water. Swallow tablet whole.
warnings: Promptly report severe or unexplained muscle weakness or dark-colored urine.
Periodic liver function tests may be recommended by your doctor.

labelPurpose: Treatment of confirmed bacterial infections of the urinary tract, gastrointestinal tract, and chest.
labelDirections: Take with plenty of water. Do not take with dairy products or antacids alone.
warnings: Associated with risk of tendonitis and tendon rupture; stop if tendon pain occurs.
May increase sensitivity to sunlight; avoid prolonged sun exposure.
Do not take with calcium-fortified beverages or iron supplements simultaneously.

labelPurpose: Short-term relief of pain and inflammation in joints, muscles, and post-traumatic conditions.
labelDirections: Take with or after food. Swallow whole; do not break, chew, or crush.
warnings: Risk of gastrointestinal irritation and bleeding with prolonged use.
Use caution in patients with cardiovascular or renal disease.
Do not combine with other NSAIDs without medical supervision.

labelPurpose: Relief of nausea, vomiting, and feelings of fullness or bloating.
labelDirections: Take approximately 15 to 30 minutes before meals. Use the lowest effective dose for the shortest duration.
warnings: Do not exceed recommended dose or treatment duration of 7 days.
Consult physician if experiencing irregular heartbeat.
Contraindicated in severe hepatic impairment.
sourceTitle: NHS UK Domperidone Monograph / CDSCO Safety Warnings

labelPurpose: Treatment of anaerobic bacterial and parasitic infections including amoebiasis and giardiasis.
labelDirections: Swallow whole with a glass of water, with or after food. Complete the full prescribed course.
warnings: Strictly avoid alcohol during treatment and for at least 48 hours after the last dose.
May cause severe disulfiram-like reaction (nausea, flushing) with alcohol.
May impart a harmless dark or reddish-brown color to urine.
sourceTitle: NHS UK Metronidazole Monograph / WHO Model Formulary

labelPurpose: Treatment of intestinal parasitic worm infestations.
labelDirections: Chew or crush the tablet and swallow with water, preferably with food.
warnings: Not recommended during pregnancy without strict physician advice.
Consult doctor if symptoms do not improve after 2 to 3 weeks.
Follow deworming instructions carefully.
sourceTitle: WHO Model List of Essential Medicines / DailyMed FDA Albendazole

labelPurpose: Treatment of a wide variety of bacterial infections, acne, and malaria prophylaxis.
labelDirections: Swallow with a full glass of water while sitting or standing upright. Do not lie down for 30 minutes after taking.
warnings: Must be taken upright with ample water to prevent esophageal irritation.
Causes skin sensitivity to ultraviolet light (sunburn).
Avoid taking within 2 hours of antacids, iron, or calcium products.

labelPurpose: Management of hypertension and kidney protection in diabetic patients.
labelDirections: Take once daily with water, with or without food, at the same time each day.
warnings: Do not take during pregnancy; may cause fetal injury.
May cause dizziness when standing up quickly from a sitting position.
Periodic monitoring of serum potassium may be required.

labelPurpose: Treatment of hypertension, angina, and maintenance after myocardial infarction.
labelDirections: Take with or immediately following a meal. Swallow whole with water.
warnings: Do not discontinue abruptly; sudden cessation can worsen angina.
Use with caution in asthma or severe respiratory diseases.
May mask warning signs of low blood sugar in diabetic patients.

labelPurpose: Relief of bronchospasm in bronchial asthma and chronic bronchitis.
labelDirections: Take as directed by your physician. Swallow whole with water.
warnings: Use cautiously in patients with cardiovascular disease or hyperthyroidism.
Inform physician if shortness of breath does not resolve promptly.
Not a replacement for preventative asthma controller medication.

labelPurpose: Replacement therapy for hypothyroidism (underactive thyroid gland).
labelDirections: Take once daily in the morning on an empty stomach, at least 30 minutes before breakfast.
warnings: Take consistently on an empty stomach with a full glass of water.
Do not take within 4 hours of calcium, iron, or antacid supplements.
Requires regular blood testing (TSH) to adjust proper dosage.
commonSideEffects: Usually none if dose is correct; palpitations or sweating indicate over-replacement
sourceTitle: NHS UK Levothyroxine Monograph / DailyMed FDA

labelPurpose: Treatment of allergic conditions such as hay fever, urticaria, and allergic skin reactions.
labelDirections: Take as directed by a healthcare professional with water.
warnings: Causes pronounced drowsiness; do not drive or operate machinery.
Avoid all alcoholic beverages while taking this medication.
Use with caution in glaucoma and urinary retention.

labelPurpose: Restoration of body fluids and electrolytes lost due to dehydration and diarrhea.
labelDirections: Dissolve the entire sachet contents in exactly 1 liter of clean drinking water. Drink as directed.
warnings: Dissolve only in water; do not mix in milk, juice, or soup.
Discard any solution remaining 24 hours after preparation.
Seek urgent medical attention if dehydration symptoms worsen.
commonSideEffects: Mild nausea if consumed too rapidly
sourceTitle: WHO Model List of Essential Medicines / UNICEF ORS Guidelines
notes: Standard WHO low-osmolarity oral rehydration formula.

labelPurpose: Prevention and treatment of vitamin C deficiency (scurvy) and nutritional supplementation.
labelDirections: Chew tablet thoroughly before swallowing. May be taken with or without food.
warnings: Do not exceed the recommended daily allowance without medical advice.
High doses may cause mild stomach upset or diarrhea.
Use caution in patients with a history of kidney stones.
sourceTitle: NHS UK Vitamin C / DailyMed FDA Ascorbic Acid

labelPurpose: Treatment of bacterial infections including respiratory tract, ear, sinus, urinary tract, skin, and soft tissue infections.
labelDirections: Take with food to reduce gastrointestinal discomfort. Complete the full course as prescribed by a physician.
warnings: Contraindicated in patients with a history of hypersensitivity to penicillin or cephalosporin class antibiotics.
Complete the entire prescribed course; stopping early can cause treatment failure and antibiotic resistance.
Use with caution in patients with a history of hepatic dysfunction or severe renal impairment.
sourceTitle: National List of Essential Medicines (NLEM) 2022 / Central Drugs Standard Control Organization (CDSCO)
notes: Broad-spectrum combination antibiotic containing a beta-lactam antibiotic and a beta-lactamase inhibitor.
